title: Aged Inventory Surcharge Schedule, Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN)
content:
Inventory age in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) is measured in days since each unit was received, first in first out, on the monthly assessment date. Surcharge rates are set per program and per age band.

| Program | Aged 181 to 270 days, USD per cubic foot | Aged 271 to 365 days, USD per cubic foot | Aged 366 days or more, USD per cubic foot | Aged 366 days or more, per-unit alternative (USD per unit) | Calendar days after activation with no aged surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 1.50 | 3.80 | 6.90 | 0.15 | 365 |
| FBN Core Program | 1.50 | 3.80 | 6.90 | 0.15 | 0 (no exemption) |
| FBN Growth Program | 1.50 | 3.80 | 6.90 | 0.15 | 0 (no exemption) |
| FBN Scale Program | 1.25 | 3.40 | 6.40 | 0.15 | 0 (no exemption) |
| FBN Premier Program | 1.00 | 3.00 | 5.90 | 0.15 | 0 (no exemption) |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 0.75 | 2.60 | 5.40 | 0.15 | 0 (no exemption) |

## Notes

- Age basis, every program: days since the unit was received, counted first in first out.
- In the band of 366 days or more, the per-cubic-foot amount and the per-unit alternative times the units are compared and the greater of the two is charged.
- An exemption of 0 days means the enrollment has no exemption period; only FBN Starter Program carries one, of 365 calendar days after activation.

## Band boundaries

| Unit age on the assessment date | Band |
|---|---|
| 180 days | no surcharge band |
| 181 days | 181 to 270 days |
| 270 days | 181 to 270 days |
| 271 days | 271 to 365 days |
| 365 days | 271 to 365 days |
| 366 days | 366 days or more |
